source_pr_title: fix(ci): permit unfree claude-code in repo-local devenv eval
author: codeant-ai
body:
**Suggestion:** `permitted_unfree_packages` is not the nixpkgs configuration shape used by devenv, so it does not permit `pkgs.claude-code` and CI evaluation still fails.
